description: This is a Java source class implementing a business step for handling loan account ownership transfers, including methods for managing transfer lifecycle, interactions with repositories, and event notifications within a loan processing system.

classes.name: LoanAccountOwnerTransferBusinessStep
classes.description: A Spring component implementing business logic to manage loan ownership transfers, including processing different transfer states and notifying relevant systems.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to process the loan ownership transfer logic based on current transfer data and statuses.

methods.name: handleSale
methods.description: Handles the sale transfer logic, including declining or confirming the sale, and notifying events.

methods.name: handleBuyback
methods.description: Handles buyback transfer logic, including creating new transfer entries and updating statuses accordingly.

methods.name: buybackAsset
methods.description: Completes the buyback process, updating transfer records, journal entries, and repository states.

methods.name: sellAssetOrDecline
methods.description: Determines whether an asset sale can proceed or should be declined based on transferability.

methods.name: sellAsset
methods.description: Performs the asset sale process, including transfer activation and journal entry posting.

methods.name: determinePreviousOwnerAndCleanupIfNeeded
methods.description: Determines the previous owner during transfer and handles cleanup if necessary, especially with delayed settlement.

methods.name: determineActiveStatus
methods.description: Determines whether the transfer should be marked as ACTIVE or ACTIVE_INTERMEDIATE.

methods.name: getActiveIntermediateOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves the current active intermediate transfer, throwing if not found.

methods.name: createAssetOwnerTransferDetails
methods.description: Creates transfer details record, including outstanding interest and fees.

methods.name: createActiveMapping
methods.description: Creates and saves a mapping between loan ID and transfer record.

methods.name: handleSameDaySaleAndBuyback
methods.description: Handles cases where sale and buyback happen on the same day, cancelling both transfers.

methods.name: cancelTransfer
methods.description: Cancels a given transfer by creating a new cancelled entry.

methods.name: activatePendingEntry
methods.description: Activates a pending transfer by creating an active entry effective from the next day.

methods.name: declinePendingEntry
methods.description: Declines a pending transfer, expiring it on the same day.

methods.name: createNewEntryAndExpireOldEntry
methods.description: Creates a new transfer entry and expires the old one by setting its effective date.

methods.name: expireTransfer
methods.description: Updates a transfer to set its end date, effectively expiring it.

methods.name: determineExpectedActiveStatus
methods.description: Determines the appropriate active status for a transfer based on its current status.

methods.name: getEnumStyledName
methods.description: Returns the enum-style name used for this business step.

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of this business step.
